what: After scrolling to the very bottom, further wheel input pushes the whole body panel up, revealing the big footer logo pinned beneath at the bottom of the screen — the more wheel input accumulates the further it opens (a cubic curve that slows at the end, following by .13 per frame), and when the wheel stops it drops back with .62s cubic-bezier(.83,.02,.23,.99) and covers again. Scrolling up closes it 1.35x faster

options.target: Selector for the body panel to push up, default main
options.step: Max roll received per Frame (px), default 24
options.idle: Time counted as a stop (ms), default 45
options.smooth: Rate at which progress follows, default .13
options.back: Multiplier for closing when rolling up, default 1.35

note: The body board (target) must sit on a layer (z-index) above the Footer with an opaque background to cover it. Hidden on touch screens since there is no wheel (hover: none). If Lenis exists, the end is measured by its limit.
